scientific_limitations_and_integrity.claim: Exact relative condition-number identity and late-time asymptotic for the two-time ratio inversion.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Analytic proof included; no independent audit or external validation claimed.
limitations: Does not model noise, heterogeneity, boundaries, wellbore storage, delayed yield, or uncertainty in pumping rate.
Theis already states that two observations theoretically identify transmissivity and storage; the contribution claimed here is the explicit conditioning law, not structural identifiability itself.
Related sensitivity analyses may exist outside the inspected sources; absolute novelty is not asserted.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Ideal homogeneous isotropic infinite-aquifer Theis model; known constant pumping rate and observation radius; exact drawdown observations at two times.

title: Exact conditioning law for two-time Theis inversion
